relationships.subject: Tiaoqi electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with the model group, in the EA group, the expression of miRNA-124, levels of SOD, CAT and GSH-Px, and protein expression of Bcl-2 were increased in the PFC (P<0.05)

relationships.subject: Tiaoqi electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: the positive expression of p-JAK2 and p-STAT3, level of MDA, the protein expression of Bax and Cleaved-Caspase-3, Bax/Bcl-2 ratio and neuronal apoptosis rate were reduced (P<0.05)

relationships.subject: Tiaoqi electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Tiaoqi EA can effectively relieve CPDC by regulating the miRNA-124-mediated JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway, alleviating oxidative stress and inhibiting neuronal apoptosis.

key_findings: Tiaoqi EA relieves pain-depression behaviors in CPDC rats and raises PFC miRNA-124.
EA reduces p-JAK2/p-STAT3, oxidative stress and apoptosis; miRNA-124 inhibitor reverses benefits.
